rows.grounds: feminine nominative singular participle of tuṣ; describes the goddess
compound of abhīṣṭa and pradā; feminine nominative singular
third person singular optative active of bhū

items.question: When the goddess is pleased by this worship, does she become the giver of desired things?
premises: Pleased goddess becomes giver of desired things.
Thus marks the stated ritual result.
items.inference: The verse states that the goddess, once pleased, becomes the giver of desired things.
uncertainties: Whether bhavet is optative or another modal reading.
Whether abhīṣṭapradā is a single compound or appositional phrase.
items.plain_english: Thus, pleased, she becomes the giver of desired things.
